methodology.scope: Exact tokenizer counts of captured synthetic document reads, serialized update inputs, and command outputs; not provider-billed session usage.
methodology.auth: Authorization headers/config and API tokens excluded. No model API calls were made.
methodology.creation: Each method creates a fresh child under the explicit confirmed test parent; setup creation excluded from read/edit workflow totals.
methodology.filtering: curl filtered variants use actual read/update responses projected to required fields. Local-patch variants count a small literal replacement instead of returning full local file content to the model.
methodology.safety: Content verification compares visible text in order, macro names/parameters, links, task states, table-cell counts, and code text after an independent REST re-read. Generated task IDs, inter-block layout whitespace, one final code newline, javascript/js language aliases, and a panel title moved into visible body are accepted normalizations and are not byte equality. It is not complete visual fidelity verification.
methodology.overhead: Session tool schemas and authoring prerequisites are recorded separately; wire/result envelopes are marked wireOnly and excluded from scenario totals.
limitations: CLI local-patch and filtered curl local-patch use local file manipulation; any coding agent can implement equivalent local preprocessing.
Tool call scaffolding, hidden reasoning, cache hits, history replay, client context injection and billing are not measured.
Failed or lossy methods must not be compared as successful token savings.
MCP Markdown replacement on rich native content is an explicit stress case; the official format guide recommends HTML for such edits.
